description: Hand-written spoken-style passages with reference punctuation. Inputs are derived by lib/text.mjs (stripped / lowercased / commas-only). Categories cover meetings, streams, lectures, support calls, numbers, abbreviations, fillers, code-switching, one-sentence turns and long single sentences that must NOT be split.
